# Port of lib/pubid/iala/parser.rb: [IALA ]<type><number>[.dots][-subs]
# [ Ed X.Y | :edX.Y] [(L)], plus the Annex-to-base form. The annex
# letter guard (!lower) keeps "Ed 1" from mis-capturing.
#
# Edition-2 conversion with typed model bindings. Deviations from the
# v1 tree:
# - the dotted continuation and the dash subpart repeat capture-bearing
#   rule refs (the itu `parts` shape): a repetition over a capture-less
#   unit harvested as a bare span binds differently per engine, so the
#   bindings read the inner captures through the array paths
#   `doc_number_dots[].dotted_segment` and `subpart[].subpart_number`.
#   The dotted segment gains its own capture (`dotted_segment`); the
#   subpart keeps its `subpart_number` capture, hoisted out of the
#   inline repetition into a rule ref of its own.
# - the annex base composite stays unbound. Every capture inside it
#   (type_letter, doc_number, …) is the only occurrence of its name on
#   the annex path, so the binding harvest hoists it to the top level:
#   the builder reads one flat map for the plain and the annex form
#   alike and dispatches on :annex_marker. edition_value and language
#   hoist out of their edition/language_group composites the same way.

grammar PubidIala version "0.1.0" edition 2 {
  type_letter = ("GA" / "S" / "R" / "G" / "M" / "C" / "A" / "L" / "X" / "P") as type_letter
  doc_number = (1*digit) as doc_number
  dotted_number = dot (1*digit) as dotted_segment
  number_with_dots = doc_number (*dotted_number) as doc_number_dots
  subpart_number = dash (1*digit) as subpart_number
  subpart = (1*subpart_number) as subpart
  code = type_letter number_with_dots [subpart]
  edition_value = (1*digit *(dot 1*digit)) as edition_value
  edition_human = (space "Ed" space edition_value) as edition
  edition_compact = (colon "ed" edition_value) as edition
  language_group = ([space] "(" ("E" / "F" / "S" / "C" / "A" / "R") as language ")") as language_group
  annex_identifier = {
    ((publisher type_letter number_with_dots [subpart]) as base)
    space
    ("Annex" / "ANNEX") as annex_marker
    [ (space upper as annex_letter !lower) ]
    [edition_human / edition_compact]
    [language_group]
  }
  plain_identifier = {
    publisher code [edition_human / edition_compact] [language_group]
  }
  identifier = {
      annex_identifier
    / plain_identifier
  }
  publisher = ["IALA "]
  upper = %x41-5A
  lower = %x61-7A
  digit = %x30-39
  dash = "-"
  colon = ":"
  dot = "."
  space = " "
  entry identifier: identifier

  bindings identifier {
    type_letter -> type_letter (string)
    doc_number -> doc_number (string)
    dotted_segment -> doc_number_dots[].dotted_segment (string)
    subpart_number -> subpart[].subpart_number (string)
    edition_value -> edition_value (string)
    language -> language (string)
    annex_marker -> annex_marker (string)
    annex_letter -> annex_letter (string)
  }

  test {
    accept "G1040"
    accept "GA1040"
    accept "IALA S1070 Ed 2.0"
    accept "R1016:ed2.0(F)"
    accept "C0103-1 Ed 3.0"
    accept "IALA L2.1.11 Ed 2"
    accept "IALA G1128 Annex A Ed 1.6"
    accept "IALA G1045 Annex Ed 1"
    accept "IALA A12-01 (E)"
    reject "nonsense"
    example "G1040" { type_letter: "G", doc_number: "1040" }
    example "GA01.01" {
      type_letter: "GA",
      doc_number: "01",
      doc_number_dots: [ { dotted_segment: "01" } ],
    }
    example "C0103-1" {
      type_letter: "C",
      doc_number: "0103",
      subpart: [ { subpart_number: "1" } ],
    }
    example "IALA S1070 Ed 2.0" {
      type_letter: "S",
      doc_number: "1070",
      edition_value: "2.0",
    }
    example "IALA G1128 Annex A Ed 1.6" {
      type_letter: "G",
      doc_number: "1128",
      annex_marker: "Annex",
      annex_letter: "A",
      edition_value: "1.6",
    }
  }
}
